title: Secretary of State of Nebraska

context.text: Republican Scott Petersen defeated incumbent Secretary of State Bob Evnen in the May 12, 2026 primary, 54.6% to 45.4%, so the seat has no incumbent. Democrat Sarah Slattery defeated Lee Cimfel 91.2% to 8.8%.
Bob Krist (America First Party Nebraska) and Paul Rumbaugh (Nebraska Working People Party) are also listed on the general-election ballot.

The Nebraska Secretary of State's list of Nov. 3, 2026 statewide contests shows four candidates for Secretary of State: Scott Petersen (Republican), Sarah J. Slattery (Democratic), Paul Rumbaugh (Nebraska Working People) and Bob Krist (America First).

candidates.name: Scott Petersen
candidates.ballotNote: Defeated incumbent Bob Evnen in the May 12, 2026 Republican primary.

priorities.text: Restore confidence in Nebraska elections: secure, transparent, publicly verifiable elections, accurate voter rolls and strong chain-of-custody procedures.
Local control of elections, with decisions made by Nebraskans rather than driven by federal overreach or outside influence.
Transparency and accountability in the Secretary of State's office.

candidates.name: Sarah Slattery
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary over Lee Cimfel.
candidates.currentRole: Chef and small-business owner; Plattsmouth Library Board member

priorities.text: Bring public trust back to the office, citing the rejection of ballot-initiative petition signatures and the threatened release of voter data to the federal government.
Make voting easier and more accessible, including same-day voter registration.
Support Nebraska business growth, and expand voter education about the new voter ID law.

statements.quote: Now that we have a Voter ID law on the books, offering same-day registration would be easier and more secure than ever before!
statements.context: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, on same-day registration; she does not address proof of citizenship

candidates.name: Bob Krist
candidates.currentRole: Retired Air Force lieutenant colonel; former state senator

priorities.text: Administer elections fairly and impartially: make it easy to vote legally and difficult to cheat, and certify results regardless of who wins.
Increase transparency, keep verifiable safeguards in place, and support county election officials.

researchNotes: Slate: confirmed against the Nebraska Secretary of State's official Nov. 3, 2026 statewide contest list, which matches Ballotpedia's four candidates. No Krist/Rumbaugh polling found; both are listed minimal. Rumbaugh's site lists no platform text. The open-seat race follows the incumbent's primary loss. The question of proof of citizenship was not addressed in any candidate's own words that was found, so no stances are recorded.
